description.value: Scoopz Ice Cream Parlor is an ice cream shop on Lorne Street in downtown Kamloops, a city that sits at the junction of two major river valleys and sees intense summer heat — making a cold treat a genuine draw for touring cyclists. Its downtown location places it within easy reach of the Trans Canada Trail corridor and the Thompson River cycling routes that pass through the city.
